zh: 车辆铭牌改用服务端Gemini图片识别，免费额度不足时停止调用
换图清空旧车信息，重新识别保留手工修正，可疑字段突出提示
原图与草稿保留，核对后归档，审批入库流程保持有效
en: Server-side Gemini vehicle label recognition; stop when free quota is exhausted
New photos clear stale fields; AI rechecks preserve manual corrections and flag uncertain fields
Original image and draft retained; review before archiving and approved intake
